expectations.evidence: All figures survive (41 to 19 min p95, 12% to 87% in two weeks, 3 of 11 services at 70%, 6 min from shards, $2,400/month, Priya's quote), and the closing "three services and a missing cache explained most of the wait" only restates the original's own claims.
The rewrite has no em dashes, cliches or staged reveals; the stock intro, "game changer" and "journey" language are gone, and "It now finishes in 19 minutes at p95." states the result plainly.
Sentence length varies and the wording is plain and concrete, as in "Nobody likes waiting on CI. We were waiting a lot." and "It was downloading the same dependencies over and over."

It stays an engineering team blog post, with a direct, unhyped voice, a code block and a collegial close ("If your builds are slow, don't guess. Benchmark first."), and it is neither jokey nor a bullet list.
